{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Create a cleaned version: replace -999 with NaN for biomarker_baseline
trial_df_clean = trial_df.copy()
trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999, pd.NA)

# Check how many are left after cleaning
print("Number of missing biomarker_baseline after cleaning:")
print(trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].isna().sum())

# Check the mean biomarker_baseline by arm (after cleaning)
mean_baseline_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print("Mean biomarker_baseline by arm (cleaned):")
print(mean_baseline_by_arm)

# Check the mean biomarker_final by arm
mean_final_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_final'].mean()
print("Mean biomarker_final by arm (cleaned):")
print(mean_final_by_arm)

# Check the change in biomarker (final - baseline) by arm
trial_df_clean['biomarker_change'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_final'] - trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline']
mean_change_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean()
print("Mean biomarker change by arm (cleaned):")
print(mean_change_by_arm)"}
